title: Lightning QBR standup + readout script (15m)
content:
Purpose:
- Fast, executive-friendly QBR format for high-velocity accounts where execs want a 15-minute alignment and a clear renewal next-step.
- Use as replacement for longer QBRs when the account is low-risk or on a renewal runway with simple asks.

Audience:
- Exec sponsor (15m), Product owner (5m optional), CSM facilitator (owner), Engineering SME (optional tech check), Renewal owner.

Format overview (15 minutes total):
- 0:00–00:90 (90s) - Kickoff + one-line objective from sponsor
  - Facilitator: "Objective: decide go/no-go on renewal outreach cadence and 2 action owners."
- 01:30–05:00 (3.5m) - Health snapshot (CSM)
  - 3 quick signals: usage delta (30/90d), error/latency trend, key feature adoption (e.g., embedding pipeline on/off).
  - Slide: 3 bullets, 1 inline chart (screenshot).
- 05:00–08:00 (3m) - Risk & blockers (engineering/RnD)
  - Call out any production incidents, outstanding bugs blocking scale, and ETA windows.
- 08:00–11:30 (3.5m) - Success metrics & value recap (customer PO)
  - ROI note: active seats, cost savings, internal NPS highlight (one stat).
- 11:30–14:00 (2.5m) - Renewal ask & options (CSM + Finance)
  - Option A (renew as-is), Option B (expand to Dedicated), Option C (pilot private). Price bands pre-approved by SalesOps.
- 14:00–15:00 (1m) - Decision + next steps (names + due dates)
  - Facilitator reads decision, assigns owners verbally, records in decision ledger.

Facilitator script (compact):
- Intro (00:00)
  - "Thanks all — quick round: name + 1-line priority for today. Goal: land renewal next step in 15 minutes."
- Health readout prompt (01:15)
  - "Marcus — 90s: usage, latency, top adoption metric. If you need more time, we book follow-up."
- Risk check prompt (05:00)
  - "Priya — call out anything blocking scale or outstanding SLAs. If incident, give ETA or rollback plan."
- Value recap prompt (08:30)
  - "Customer PO — 90s: one-sentence impact, one quote (if available)."
- Renewal close (11:30)
  - "Options on table: A/B/C. Which would you like to proceed with? If undecided, what's the blocker and who owns it?"
- Decision readback (14:30)
  - "Decision: <X>. Owners: <A owns>, <B owns>. Follow-up: calendar invite + update Confluence page."

Preflight checklist (CSM — complete 48 hrs before):
- Confirm exec availability (calendar confirmed) — put time zone in calendar invite
- Attach 1-pager: current usage chart, 90d trend, 3 adoption flags, renewal options with bands
- Validate data sources: billing API, usage dashboard (screenshot latest 24h), incident tracker snapshot
- Confirm pricing bands with SalesOps (linked doc)
- Prepare decision ledger template (one-line decision + owners + due date)
- Slack pre-brief with exec sponsor: 1 message with meeting objective

Decision ledger (template to paste into meeting notes):
- Decision: 
- Rationale (1 line):
- Owners: 
- Due date: 
- Follow-up doc: (confluence link)

Post-meeting ops (CSM owner — within 24h):
- Send summary email to meeting participants + exec sponsor (include decision ledger)
- Open SFDC renewal task + link meeting notes
- If action requires engineering, open ticket: tag eng-oncall and link owner
- Schedule 30m deep-dive if unresolved items > 2 (include a tech triage + roadmap owner)

Fallback scripts / common objections (cheat sheet):
- "We need more time to evaluate performance" -> Ask: what data would change your mind? Offer 14-day performance SLA pilot and package a short evaluation plan. Owner: CSM + Eng.
- "Price is too high" -> Offer: present 1) usage-based tiering, 2) small pilot to show value (90d), 3) finance contact for a pre-approved discount band. Owner: SalesOps + CSM.
- "Security/compliance questions" -> Route to Private deployment checklist + schedule follow-up with Security PM.

Notes to self / rough ideas (work-in-progress):
- Consider a "pre-check" 5-minute async update (CSM posts the 3 bullets in Slack thread 24h prior) to reduce live time
- Template for 1-pager should be standardized: header (customer, ARR, renewal window), 3-line health, 1 chart, 2 asks
- Could build a Playbook macro in Console that exports the 1-pager automatically (linked to account id)

Open questions / unresolved:
- Do we need a separate exec-only template vs. mixed exec+PO? (pros/cons?)
- Which renewal reason codes map to an auto-followup vs. manual AE escalation? (list to create)

Quick links / references:
- Confluence: Quarterly lightning format (see linked_artifacts)
- Slack: #cs-qbr-ops thread for scheduling templates
- Jira: CS-3247 (lightning QBR rollout tasks)

Version history:
- v0.1 2025-01-14 Nina A — initial skeleton
- v0.2 2025-02-26 Marcus L — added fallback scripts and preflight checklist

---
Checklist before publishing final: move to 'in_review' once SalesOps approves pricing bands; attach final 1-pager template; run pilot with 3 low-risk accounts.
